about.title: About us
about.subtitle: Mawaredna Mostaqbalna
about.description: Mawariduna Mustaqbaluna (Our Resources, Our Future) is a company specializing in the collection, processing, and recycling of agricultural and sugarcane waste to produce compost and organic fertilizers. The company aims to transform waste—previously a burden on farmers and the environment—into a beneficial organic resource that enriches the soil and boosts agricultural productivity.
about.vision: To become one of Egypt’s leading companies in the management and recycling of agricultural and sugarcane waste, and in the production of high-value organic products.
about.mission: Transforming agricultural waste into useful resources and products, achieving sustainable economic and environmental value, while providing reliable products and services to farmers and customers.
goals: Collecting, recycling, and utilizing agricultural and sugarcane waste.
Transforming agricultural waste into products with economic and environmental value.
Producing high-quality plant-based compost that improves soil properties and agricultural productivity.
Providing integrated solutions for agricultural waste management and processing.
Supporting farmers through agricultural consulting, delivery services, and technical support.
Contributing to the reduction of agricultural waste and mitigating its environmental impact.
Supporting the circular economy and generating added value from waste.
Expanding into agricultural waste-based products and biofuels in the future.
Building partnerships with farmers, sugar mills, agricultural companies, and relevant institutions.
Creating green jobs and generating sustainable economic value.

compost.title: Mawaredna Mostaqbalna Compost
compost.subtitle: Natural, high-quality plant compost made from sugarcane residues
compost.description: Mawaredna Mostaqbalna Compost is a natural plant-based compost produced from sugarcane residues through appropriate processing and composting processes. It transforms agricultural waste into a useful organic resource that supports soil improvement, plant growth, and agricultural productivity.
compost.imageAlt: Mawaredna Mostaqbalna compost made from sugarcane residues

components.title: Beneficial Microorganisms
components.description: Contains beneficial microorganisms that support biological soil activity.

compost.nutrientsNote: The listed values are approximate and may vary depending on raw material characteristics, processing and composting conditions, and laboratory analysis.
benefits: A sustainable and environmentally friendly product that contributes to recycling sugarcane residues and supporting sustainable agriculture.
Supports plant growth and provides a suitable environment for roots, helping improve crop productivity and quality.
Activates the soil biologically through beneficial microorganisms that help convert complex nutrients into forms that are easier for plants to absorb.
Increases the water-holding capacity of sandy soils, helping improve irrigation water availability.
Helps improve soil aeration, water infiltration, and drainage through its cellulose fiber content.
Helps improve soil properties and increase its organic matter content.
Contributes to reducing agricultural waste by utilizing it as a beneficial organic resource.
Appropriate composting and processing processes help eliminate weed seeds and reduce certain pathogens.
compost.source: The compost is produced from agricultural residues, particularly sugarcane residues generated by sugar factories, transforming agricultural waste into an organic product that benefits soil and agriculture.
compost.ctaDescription: Invest in healthier soil and more sustainable agriculture. Contact us to determine the appropriate quantity for your farm and learn about delivery and technical support options.

process.title: From waste to product
process.subtitle: The stages from collecting agricultural residues to using compost in the field.

sugarcane.title: Sugarcane residues
sugarcane.subtitle: Bringing sugarcane by-products into the recycling and processing system.
sugarcane.introBody: Growing and milling sugarcane leaves behind large volumes of plant residues. The company collects these residues and feeds them into its processing and recycling system to produce organic products and compost, instead of letting them go to waste.
sugarcane.step1: Collection from growing and milling sites.
sugarcane.step2: Sorting, initial preparation and size reduction.
sugarcane.step3: Blending into the compost windrows with other plant residues.
sugarcane.step4: Processing, fermentation and turning through to the finished product.
